```{r}
# filter to one spec (e.g., "log_grp0p40" or "raw_grp0p20_cap0p30"), set this:
# SPEC_TAG <- 'log_grp0p4'

# Determine if log or raw based on SPEC_TAG
IS_LOG <- grepl("^log_", SPEC_TAG)
FIG_PREFIX <- ifelse(IS_LOG, "l", "r")  # l for log results, r for raw results
```

```{r}
# Small utilities -------------------------------------------------------------
ff <- function(pattern, spec = SPEC_TAG, dir = OUTPUT_DIR) {
  all <- list.files(dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  # keep only .csv / .tsv (ignore .png, .pdf, etc.)
  all <- all[grepl("\\.(csv|tsv)$", all, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (!is.null(spec)) all <- all[grepl(spec, all, fixed = TRUE)]
  if (length(all) == 0) stop("No CSV/TSV files matched: ", pattern,
                             if (!is.null(spec)) paste0(" + spec=", spec))
  # Prefer CSV if both exist
  csvs <- all[grepl("\\.csv$", all, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(csvs)) return(csvs[1])
  all[1]
}

# Reader that auto-picks CSV vs TSV and reports parse issues
read_table_auto <- function(path) {
  line1 <- tryCatch(readr::read_lines(path, n_max = 1), error = function(e) "")
  if (length(line1) == 0) line1 <- ""
  if (grepl("\t", line1)) {
    df <- readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else {
    df <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  }
  pbs <- readr::problems(df)
  if (nrow(pbs)) {
    message("Parsing issues in ", basename(path), ":\n")
    print(pbs)
  }
  df
}

read_csv_safe <- function(path) read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)

post_line_x <- function(df) {
  # expects columns date (Date) and is_post (0/1)
  d <- df %>% filter(is_post == 1) %>% arrange(date)
  if (nrow(d)) d$date[[1]] else NA
}

# Helper function to generate numbered filenames
fig_filename <- function(base_name, fig_num) {
  paste0(fig_num, FIG_PREFIX, "_", base_name, ".png")
}
```

# 1) Treated vs Synthetic (Combined)
```{r}
# 1) Treated vs Synthetic (Combined) ------------------------------------------
plot_treated_vs_synth <- function(series_file = ff("^series_combined_")) {
  dat <- read_csv_safe(series_file) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
  vline_x <- post_line_x(dat)
  
  # Use column names based on IS_LOG: log uses on_model_scale_*, raw uses treated_levels/synthetic_levels
  if (IS_LOG) {
    treated_col <- "on_model_scale_treated"
    synth_col <- "on_model_scale_synth"
  } else {
    treated_col <- "treated_levels"
    synth_col <- "synthetic_levels"
  }

  # Calculate y range for text positioning - align end of text with max y
  y_range <- range(c(dat[[treated_col]], dat[[synth_col]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_text <- y_range[2]  # Position at max y so end of text aligns with max
  # Calculate date range for horizontal offset
  date_range <- as.numeric(range(dat$date, na.rm = TRUE))
  x_offset <- (date_range[2] - date_range[1]) * 0.02  # Small offset to move text away from line
  
  # Calculate policy publication date (3 months after anticipation)
  vline_x2 <- if (!is.na(vline_x)) vline_x + months(3) else NA

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = date)) +

    # Lines
    geom_line(aes(
      y = .data[[treated_col]],
      linetype = "Treated",
      color    = "Treated"
    ), linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_line(aes(
      y = .data[[synth_col]],
      linetype = "Synthetic",
      color    = "Synthetic"
    ), linewidth = 1.1) +

    # Post-intervention vertical line (Anticipation) - red for analysis
    { if (!is.na(vline_x)) geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, color = "red") } +
    
    # Policy publication vertical line (3 months later)
    { if (!is.na(vline_x2)) geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x2, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) } +
    
    # Add "Anticipation" text label - end of text at max y, offset from line
    { if (!is.na(vline_x)) 
        annotate("text", x = vline_x + x_offset, y = y_text, label = "Anticipation",
                 angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, color = "black")
    } +
    
    # Add "Policy Publication" text label - end of text at max y, offset from line
    { if (!is.na(vline_x2)) 
        annotate("text", x = vline_x2 + x_offset, y = y_text, label = "Policy Publication",
                 angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, color = "black")
    } +

    # Manual colors
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Treated"   = "#12529A",
        "Synthetic" = "#F0C37E"
      )
    ) +

    # Manual linetypes
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Treated"   = "solid",
        "Synthetic" = "dashed"
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      x = "",
      y = ifelse(IS_LOG, "Model scale (log)", "Model scale (levels)"),
      color = "",
      linetype = "",
      title = "Treated vs Synthetic — Combined"
    ) +

    # --- CLEAN & PRETTY THEME ---
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +  # base fontsize ↑
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.4, "cm"),

      # more space for the top legend
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )
}

print(plot_treated_vs_synth())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, fig_filename("treated_vs_synth", 1)), plot_treated_vs_synth(), 
       width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
```

# 2) Gap series (Combined)
```{r}
# 2) Gap series (Combined) ----------------------------------------------------
plot_gap_combined <- function(gap_file = ff("^gap_combined_")) {
  dat <- read_csv_safe(gap_file) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
  vline_x <- post_line_x(dat)
  
  # Determine gap column name - check what's actually available
  # For log: gap_model_scale, for raw: could be gap_levels or gap_model_scale
  if (IS_LOG) {
    gap_col <- "gap_model_scale"
  } else {
    # For raw data, check which column exists
    if ("gap_levels" %in% names(dat)) {
      gap_col <- "gap_levels"
    } else if ("gap_model_scale" %in% names(dat)) {
      gap_col <- "gap_model_scale"
    } else {
      stop("Could not find gap column. Available columns: ", 
           paste(names(dat), collapse = ", "))
    }
  }

  # Calculate y range for text positioning - align end of text with max y
  y_range <- range(dat[[gap_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_text <- y_range[2]  # Position at max y so end of text aligns with max
  # Calculate date range for horizontal offset
  date_range <- as.numeric(range(dat$date, na.rm = TRUE))
  x_offset <- (date_range[2] - date_range[1]) * 0.02  # Small offset to move text away from line
  
  # Calculate policy publication date (3 months after anticipation)
  vline_x2 <- if (!is.na(vline_x)) vline_x + months(3) else NA

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = date, y = .data[[gap_col]])) +

    # Zero reference line
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.9, color = "grey40") +

    # Gap line
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = '#5894D0') + # "#12529A"

    # Post-intervention vertical line (Anticipation) - red for analysis
    { if (!is.na(vline_x)) 
        geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, color = "red")
    } +
    
    # Policy publication vertical line (3 months later)
    { if (!is.na(vline_x2)) 
        geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x2, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8)
    } +
    
    # Add "Anticipation" text label - end of text at max y, offset from line
    { if (!is.na(vline_x)) 
        annotate("text", x = vline_x + x_offset, y = y_text, label = "Anticipation",
                 angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, color = "black")
    } +
    
    # Add "Policy Publication" text label - end of text at max y, offset from line
    { if (!is.na(vline_x2)) 
        annotate("text", x = vline_x2 + x_offset, y = y_text, label = "Policy Publication",
                 angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, color = "black")
    } +

    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Gap (model scale)",
      title = "Gap Series — Combined"
    ) +

    # --- PRETTY THEME (matching your other plot) ---
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),

      # spacing
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )
}

print(plot_gap_combined())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, fig_filename("gap_combined", 2)), 
       plot_gap_combined(), width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
```

```{r}
# ----- Scatter + line ---------
plot_prefit_scatter <- function(scatter_file = ff("^prefit_scatter_combined_points_")) {
  library(hrbrthemes)   # for geom_labelsmooth()

  dat <- read_csv_safe(scatter_file)

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = treated_levels, y = synthetic_levels)) +

    # Scatter points
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.8, color = '#12529A') + # '#5894D0'

    # Smooth regression line with label
    geom_labelsmooth(
      aes(label = "OLS fit"),
      method   = "lm",
      formula  = y ~ x,
      fill     = "white",
      linewidth = 1.3,
      size     = 5,
      boxlinewidth = 0.6,
      color = "#F0C37E" #  "#D55E00", "#F0C37E", '#F2C2D8'
    ) +

    # 1:1 reference line
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1, intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.7,
      color = "grey40",
      alpha = 0.80
    ) +

    labs(
      x = "Treated (levels)",
      y = "Synthetic (levels)",
      title = "Pre-Period Fit (Levels): Combined"
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 14),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )
}

# ----- Plot and save -----
```

# 4) Unit placebo gaps overlay
```{r}
# 4) Unit placebo gaps overlay ------------------------------------------------
plot_unit_placebo_gaps <- function(
  placebos_long_file = ff("^unit_placebo_gaps_long_"),
  treated_gap_file  = ff("^gap_combined_"),
  # colors = list(placebo = "#A6A6A6", treated = "#5894D0"),  # 2 color: Grey and Blue
  colors = list(treated = "#5894D0")  # only treated color now
) {
  # Load data
  pl <- read_csv_safe(placebos_long_file) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
  tg <- read_csv_safe(treated_gap_file)   %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
  vline_x <- post_line_x(tg)
  
  # Determine gap column name - check what's actually available
  # For log: gap_model_scale, for raw: could be gap_levels or gap_model_scale
  if (IS_LOG) {
    gap_col <- "gap_model_scale"
  } else {
    # For raw data, check which column exists
    if ("gap_levels" %in% names(pl)) {
      gap_col <- "gap_levels"
    } else if ("gap_model_scale" %in% names(pl)) {
      gap_col <- "gap_model_scale"
    } else {
      stop("Could not find gap column. Available columns in placebo file: ", 
           paste(names(pl), collapse = ", "))
    }
  }
  
  # Verify the column exists in treated gap file too
  if (!gap_col %in% names(tg)) {
    stop("Column '", gap_col, "' not found in treated gap file. Available columns: ", 
         paste(names(tg), collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Assign a color to each placebo unit using Set3
  placebo_units <- unique(pl$unit)
  n_units <- length(placebo_units)
  placebo_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(min(12, n_units), "Set3"))(n_units)
  names(placebo_colors) <- placebo_units

  ggplot() +
    # Placebo lines with Set3 colors
    geom_line(data = pl, aes(x = date, y = .data[[gap_col]], group = unit, color = unit),
              alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4) +

    # Treated gap line
    geom_line(data = tg, aes(x = date, y = .data[[gap_col]]),
              color = colors$treated, linewidth = 1) +

    # Post-intervention vertical line
    { if (!is.na(vline_x)) geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) } +

    # Horizontal line at 0
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +

    # Apply Set3 colors to placebo units
    scale_color_manual(values = placebo_colors) +

    # Labels
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Gap (model scale)",
      title = "Unit Placebos (Gaps) — Combined"
    ) +

    # Remove legend
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )
}


print(plot_unit_placebo_gaps())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, fig_filename("unit_placebo_gaps", 4)), 
       plot_unit_placebo_gaps(), width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
```

```{r}
plot_mspe_hist <- function(ratios_file = ff("^unit_placebo_mspe_ratios_")) {
  r <- read_csv_safe(ratios_file)
  treated_val <- r %>% filter(is_treated == 1) %>% pull(post_pre_mspe_ratio)
  placebos <- r %>% filter(is_treated == 0)

  ggplot(placebos, aes(post_pre_mspe_ratio)) +
    
    # geom_histogram(bins = 30) + # Black & White
    # { if (length(treated_val) == 1) geom_vline(xintercept = treated_val, linetype = "dashed") } +
    
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = '#AFDBF4', color = "black", linewidth = 0.15) +
    { if (length(treated_val) == 1) geom_vline(xintercept = treated_val, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) } +
    
    labs(x = "Post/Pre MSPE ratio (placebos)", 
         y = "Count", 
         title = "Unit-placebo MSPE ratios — Combined") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),

      # spacing
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )
}
```

# 6) Origin-only / Destination-only overlays
```{r}
# 6) Origin-only / Destination-only overlays ----------------------------------
plot_origin_dest_overlays <- function(series_origin_file = ff("^series_origin_only_"),
                                      series_dest_file   = ff("^series_destination_only_")) {
  so <- read_csv_safe(series_origin_file) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    mutate(type = "Origin-only")
  sd <- read_csv_safe(series_dest_file) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    mutate(type = "Destination-only")
  vline_x <- post_line_x(so)

  p1 <- ggplot(so, aes(date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = treated_levels, linetype = "Treated")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = synthetic_levels, linetype = "Synthetic")) +
    { if (!is.na(vline_x)) geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x, linetype = "dotted") } +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Levels", linetype = "", title = "Origin-only synthetic") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )

  p2 <- ggplot(sd, aes(date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = treated_levels, linetype = "Treated")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = synthetic_levels, linetype = "Synthetic")) +
    { if (!is.na(vline_x)) geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x, linetype = "dotted") } +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Levels", linetype = "", title = "Destination-only synthetic") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )
  list(origin_only = p1, destination_only = p2)
}

ov <- plot_origin_dest_overlays()
print(ov$origin_only); print(ov$destination_only)
```

```{r}
# 7) Double-counterfactual gaps (levels) --------------------------------------
plot_double_counterfactual <- function(double_gap_file = ff("^double_counterfactual_gaps_levels_")) {
  dg <- read_csv_safe(double_gap_file) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
  vline_x <- post_line_x(dg)

  long <- dg %>%
    select(date, gap_vs_origin_levels, gap_vs_destination_levels) %>%
    pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "series", values_to = "gap")

  ggplot(long, aes(date, gap, color = series)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    geom_line() +
    { if (!is.na(vline_x)) geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") } +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("gap_vs_origin_levels" = "#AFDBF4",
                                  "gap_vs_destination_levels" = "#F2C2D8"),
                       labels = c("Gap vs origin-only", "Gap vs destination-only")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Gap (levels)", color = "", title = "Double-counterfactual gaps (levels)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )
}
```

```{r}
plot_share_projection <- function(share_file = ff("^share_of_dest_series_and_projection_")) {
  s <- read_csv_safe(share_file) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
  vline_x <- post_line_x(s)

  # Define custom colors
  line_colors <- c("Observed share" = "#5894D0",       # blue
                   "Pre-trend projection" = "#F0C37E") # orange

  ggplot(s, aes(date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = share, linetype = "Observed share", color = "Observed share"), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_line(aes(y = pretrend_projection, linetype = "Pre-trend projection", color = "Pre-trend projection"), linewidth = 0.8) +
    { if (!is.na(vline_x)) geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) } +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +

    # Apply the custom colors
    scale_color_manual(values = line_colors) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Observed share" = "solid", "Pre-trend projection" = "dashed")) +
    # scale_x_date(
    #   date_breaks = "6 months",
    #   date_labels = "%Y-%m"
    # ) +

    labs(x = NULL, y = "Share", color = "", linetype = "",
         title = "Share of destination inflow & pre-trend projection") +

    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )
}

print(plot_share_projection())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, fig_filename("share_proj", 8)), 
       plot_share_projection(), width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
```

# 9) Month-placebos histogram
```{r}
# 9) Month-placebos histogram --------------------------------------------------
plot_month_placebos_hist <- function(month_pl_file = ff("^month_placebos_"),
                                     summary_file   = ff("^summary_")) {
  # Load month-placebo data
  mp <- read_csv_safe(month_pl_file)
  
  # Try to grab the real Combined donors cumulative ATT to overlay
  real_val <- tryCatch({
    smry <- read_csv_safe(summary_file)
    smry %>% filter(grepl("^Combined donors", Model)) %>% slice(1) %>% pull(Cumulative_ATT_levels)
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  ggplot(mp %>% filter(!is.na(cum_att_levels)), aes(cum_att_levels)) +
#     geom_histogram(bins = 12) +
#     { if (is.finite(real_val)) geom_vline(xintercept = real_val,linetype="dashed")} +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 12,
      fill = '#AFDBF4',
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.2  # thin border
    ) +
    { if (is.finite(real_val)) geom_vline(
        xintercept = real_val,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "red",
        linewidth = 0.8
      )
    } +
    labs(
      x = "Cumulative ATT (levels) — placebo post windows",
      y = "Count",
      title = "Month-placebo distribution of cumulative ATT (Combined)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
    )
}

print(plot_month_placebos_hist())
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, fig_filename("month_placebos_hist", 9)), 
       plot_month_placebos_hist(), width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
```
